implementation_constants_frozen_before_f.timing: Added after Stage 07 locked and before any Stage-08 candidate was fitted or scored.
implementation_constants_frozen_before_f.Q0: Outer-training empirical rate per camera, clipped to [0.001, 0.999].
implementation_constants_frozen_before_f.Q1: Five features in this order: range, projected-hull width, projected-hull height, full-image inclusion indicator, static line-of-sight indicator. Standardize continuous features on the outer training partition; logistic regression uses L2, C=1, LBFGS, tolerance 1e-9 and maximum 2000 iterations.
implementation_constants_frozen_before_f.Q1_line_of_sight: Ray from the frozen camera centre to robot centre height z=0.20 m against collision prisms in warehouse_v2_occluders.
implementation_constants_frozen_before_f.Q2: Features are exp(-squared planar distance/(2 length_scale^2)) to every unique outer-training position, followed by sin(yaw) and cos(yaw). Logistic regression uses L2, the candidate C, LBFGS, tolerance 1e-9 and maximum 2000 iterations; RBF features are not standardized.
implementation_constants_frozen_before_f.calibration_slope_intercept: Unpenalized logistic calibration of the binary target on logit-clipped out-of-fold probability.
implementation_constants_frozen_before_f.block_macro: Arithmetic mean of the metric computed separately in every represented frozen spatial block.
implementation_constants_frozen_before_f.size_curve: For each outer fold, order its available training positions by deterministic planar maximin selection, starting at the position farthest from the training-position centroid with position ID as the tie break. For requested counts above the available outer-training positions, use the full outer-training set and report the effective count; fit the selected family and frozen hyperparameters only.

post_selection_serialization_amendment: After run v1 selected Q1, before Stage-08 lock or final-audit access, explicit Q1 feature names, image dimensions, line-of-sight target height and occluder model identity were added to the deployment artifact. Candidate fitting, scores and selection are unchanged; run v1 is retained as provenance and run v2 is eligible for lock.
authorized_population: All 9,600 commissioning_fit camera opportunities, including detector misses and Stage-06 refusals.
target: One iff the complete frozen detector-plus-admission chain supplies a usable measurement; zero otherwise.

interpretation.exact_simulator_state: Usability is deterministic at an exact pose because the frozen RGB renderer has no stochastic noise model.
interpretation.q: A smooth prediction of support under position/heading uncertainty and finite commissioning coverage, not repeated Bernoulli noise at an exact state.
interpretation.planner_inputs: camera identity, candidate x, y and heading, frozen camera/map geometry and fitted commissioning artifact only

spatial_validation.folds: Reuse the five Stage-06 whole-block folds.
spatial_validation.deployment_refit: Refit selected hyperparameters on all commissioning_fit opportunities.

candidates.description: One empirical usability rate per camera.
Per-camera logistic model using range, projected hull width/height, nominal image inclusion and map line-of-sight.
Per-camera regularized logistic field with spatial RBF features plus sine/cosine heading.

q2_grid.centres: commissioning positions in the training folds only

selection.simplicity_margin: Retain the simpler candidate when its block-macro Brier score is within 0.005 of the best candidate.
selection.calibration_gate: Do not advance a candidate with pooled expected calibration error above 0.10 or any camera with at least 100 opportunities and Brier score above its camera-constant baseline.

commissioning_size_curve.nested_subset_rule: Deterministic geometry-only maximin ordering within each training fold; prefixes form nested subsets.
commissioning_size_curve.evaluation: Use the same held-out spatial fold for every subset size and report block-macro Brier score and calibration.
commissioning_size_curve.purpose: Measure whether smaller commissioning sets are sufficient; the 240-position model remains the primary deployment fit.

prohibitions: Do not drop detector misses or gate refusals.
Do not use detector confidence from a future image as a planning feature.
Do not describe deterministic exact-state support as sensor randomness.
Do not tune on final_audit or navigation outcomes.
